author: Mark Atwood
text: Decision recorded 2026-05-11 (Mark, interactive): option (i) — add pkix-lint as a workspace dep of both pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf. Direct, explicit, matches the PKIX-8qz1 per-rule split stance (Rust handles executable side, OSCAL handles policy side). Both profile crates implement LintProfile and expose the convenience aliases. Recommendation accepted.
